formative: Short spoken and written Use tasks

readingFramework.before: A short start from something learners can see: a picture, an object or a date.
readingFramework.during: Listen first with one question, then read and do one concrete task.
readingFramework.after: Quick Challenge, then the Language Focus, then a short Use task about the learners’ own life.

vocabularyApproach.selection: The Word Notes of each chapter.
vocabularyApproach.method: Meet the word in the chapter, check its note, use it in a sentence.
vocabularyApproach.recycling: Key Terms, Master Glossary and Vocabulary Challenge.

skillsFocus.reading: Find facts and numbers in an informational text.
skillsFocus.listening: Listen for one key fact first.
skillsFocus.speaking: Short pair talk about home, school and town.

sensitiveNotes.title: Notes for the teacher
notes: The text is about EU policy. Türkiye’s own plan (2021, net zero by 2053) is in Chapter 8.

globalCitizenship.title: Our world today
globalCitizenship.description: Learners connect EU and Türkiye goals with small actions at home and school.
actions: Plan a green week for the class (Language Review).

miniProject.title: Green week
miniProject.desc: Plan five green actions for the class, one for each day.

reflectivePrompt.title: My green step
reflectivePrompt.desc: What will you change this week?

valuesEducation.title: Values
valuesEducation.description: Responsibility and not wasting, through the text’s own facts.
questions: What can one person do for a cleaner world?
